name: No Proper Cubical Face Sum
statement: An irredundant partial cube $G$ is cubical-face-prime exactly when there is no representation $G=X\oplus_IY$ in which $X$ and $Y$ are coordinate faces of $G$, their intersection is the full cube on the shared coordinate block $I$, and both factors strictly contain that common face.
hypotheses: Finite irredundant partial cubes in their canonical coordinate embedding.
